payload.title: Reader feedback as catalogue blocks in core
payload.description: Why: voting, comments, flags and Proposals are mostly built as the reader-steering plugin (PPY-77bb3b, PPY-49e9b5 1-5 stars, PPY-1546fc reader accounts, PPY-452419 conversations) but each site hand-places the islands in hooks. Make them blocks placed from data, and make the snapshot incremental before many tenants run it. Driven first by Shipped (see the Shipped-web board epic). Ends with a p.apyr.us page.
